title: nan
authors: Gutierrez H.; Cornejo J.; Bertaska I.
key_contribution: Presents uVGS-2, a micro video guidance sensor framework providing 6-DoF pose estimation using an onboard camera and Lie-algebraic PnP solver for drone and mobile robot proximity maneuvers in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
